coordinate_system: Rev3g assembly axes; carrier uses global offset below

rear_USB_opening_proposal.note: Connector clearance concept only. Actual cable overmould, approach and mating depth must determine final aperture.

assembly_sequence_proposal: Remove lid and modules/old holders; install redesigned insulated standoffs.
Lower bare carrier onto four standoffs; access all board screws before installing lid harness.
Install retained boost modules and removable Nano with correct header/socket orientation.
Install protected battery and solenoid using the existing rev3g clearance work.
Mate coil/reader/panel harnesses with slack and strain relief; keep them outside latch travel.
Check actual USB mating, lid closure, screw tools and full solenoid stroke; fit seals/port cover.
not_modelled: Actual RUN switch and its mounting/pins
Chosen Nano socket/header lengths and retention
Mating connector housings, wire bending, reader cable, battery pigtail and solder fillets
Actual reader/component height variations and RF range
Full insertion sweeps through housing walls and port
Enclosure seals and cable strain relief
Underside solder-tail, pin and fastener clearances against the real enclosure floor
release_notes: Existing enclosure CAD has not been modified for this carrier.
The earlier local envelope work was interrupted and its report is not included as final evidence.
No assembled-fit, insertion, waterproofing or printable-case release is claimed.
